title: Expectation Under a Candidate Label Law
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite type, let $C\subseteq\alpha$ be a finite set, choose a default element $a_0\in\alpha$, and let $f:\alpha\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under the law that is uniform on $C$ when $C$ is nonempty and concentrated at $a_0$ otherwise equals the uniform average of $f$ over $C$ when $C$ is nonempty, and equals $f(a_0)$ otherwise.
